one_line: Learn WHEN to steer from sparse outcome credit only: a self-written REINFORCE gate observes PE proxies (never per-step correctness) and must approach the observable ceiling that S3-A proved exists.

problem_setup.belief_source: reader read of the previous in-route junction context (memory lag); stale at post-switch junctions

frozen_components.sensor_reader: frozen linear reader (08 fit_condition_reader); no update
frozen_components.executor: rank-8 multiplicative write (C2/08); no free bias; zero-code strict no-op; frozen

credit.rl_algorithm: self-written REINFORCE + running baseline (advantage); no CausalZPolicy; no PPO/critic; no token-space RL; no end-to-end substrate update

convergence.metric: pe-gated-online heldout expert-NLL: final-window mean improves over early-window mean
convergence.on_fail: slow-or-nonconvergent (report that sparse fast learning did not hold on the surrogate)

gate_selectivity.note: gate must concentrate steering where the belief is fresh

prohibited_after_execution: change thresholds / primary arm / action space / seeds / episode budget after seeing results
train or fine-tune reader / executor / substrate
feed active_subgoal ground truth into the policy loss or gate observation
add additive/constant bias or make zero-code non-noop
token-space policy learning or end-to-end substrate update
feed evaluation readouts back into learning or change production WiringLevel
rewrite sealed verdicts: kill-eta / S2 / B screen / C2 / S3-prereq

promotion.on_all_pass: admit an independent authoritative sweep; only then consider promoting the gate policy from SHADOW

rollback: evidence lane; gate trained/evaluated in SHADOW; rollback = delete S3 artifact and new wiring code path
pre_execution_revisions: 2026-08-05: raised max_online_episodes 300->1200 and switched to minibatch REINFORCE (batch 8) after a 1-seed probe showed 300 route-episodes over 64 routes (~4.7 visits/route) under-provisioned the sparse-credit gradient (converged toward always-on, selectivity ~0). Thresholds/arms/seeds unchanged. Still a bounded, honest sample budget (~19 visits/route).
